objective: Reduce matched-token held-out NLL from current intradoc NS5 NorMuon recipe

common.matrix_optimizer: NorMuon after NS5, native outer update
common.additional_evals: 10% token knots, phase/batch boundaries, final endpoint

design: Fixed 2x2 factorial; wave 2 retains both LR levels rather than selecting one from wave 1

cautious_decay.mask: M=(W_before*u_after_NorMuon >= 0), elementwise; no mask mean normalization
cautious_decay.scope: hidden 2D matrices only; tied embedding/head/norms stay AdamW without decay
gates: mask uses pre-update weights and post-normalization descent direction
no double decay; retain base LR for decay and shape-adjusted LR only for gradient update
optimizer state serialization and eight-rank parity
finite model updates, memory and projected full-horizon runtime

analysis.replication: lock winner; fresh seed43 A versus winner
analysis.confirmation: fixed reserved subset up to 10k total, additional 9k; length and document-prefix breakdown; paired document bootstrap in Slurm
analysis.promotion: NLL direction holds on 9k and paired seed43; no >5% allocation cost increase without explicit quality/cost tradeoff
analysis.full_evaluation: locked final candidate only; do not rank different token horizons

conditional_followups.comparison: ordinary WD=.05 at winning auxiliary LR; diagnostic only, not exactly decay-matched; any mechanism claim needs stronger matched-decay control
fresh 1B 40% vs 60% per-phase tail; fixed batch switch at 50%, same warmup and second peak
conditional_followups.confounding: changes integrated LR and decay, so proves recipe effect only; do not claim pure cooldown mechanism

conditional_followups.comparison: embedding-only x2 vs norm-only x2; tied head shares exactly one parameter
locked winning recipe vs existing 4B control; rerun control if provenance/runtime changes; seed43 short replication cannot replace 4B transfer evidence

conditional_followups.note: estimate from measured 4B allocation; use exact endpoint planner, buffer availability and new reviewed cap; not a proven gain, do not continue old checkpoint

execution_constraints: No job submitted or reserved by this design
Recover and audit shared historical cost ledger before new allocation
New formal or >120-minute run requires its own reviewed authorization; prior 4B exception not reused
